_comment: Fix-only exceptions to scripts/verify-flows-size-ratchet.js. Features get none: they go into a tested osi-* module that a thin flow node loads with osiLib.require.
The gate reads this file from the base ref (origin/main), so an entry takes effect only after it merges in its own PR. Run the ratchet on the fix branch; on failure it prints the entry to add.

Fields: id (slug), kind "fix", issue (GitHub issue number), granted (YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future), reason, nodes (node id -> absolute max chars, counting On Start and On Stop code), payback_total (the per-profile total before the fix, at or below the current total).

An entry lets its listed nodes grow for 14 days from granted; only that growth may raise the total. From day 14 every run fails until each profile total is at or below payback_total. Payback is measured on the total, so while an earlier entry is outstanding, a later entry's growth is due by the earlier entry's date. A merged entry is never edited, and is deleted only once paid back; a new entry cannot be added while an expired one is still in the file.

exceptions.reason: NEW-2: when osi-valve-control fails to load, POST /api/valve/:deveui gets no HTTP answer. Build STREGA downlink + emit log ctx must answer 503 inline: the module it would call is the one that failed to load.
